topics.description: The Federal Reserve has been in the news recently due to investigations and probes into its activities. Prosecutors from Jeanine Pirro's office tried to access Federal Reserve headquarters, but were turned away. This comes as there are concerns over the Fed's renovations and potential wrongdoing.

There have been several news stories related to ICE recently, including a California man shot by ICE being arrested by the FBI and charged with assault. Additionally, there is a debate over whether Minnesota can prosecute ICE officers over a US citizen arrest.
